# Corstar Communications

> Corstar Communications is Westchester County's trusted IT Consulting and IT Managed Service Provider. Delivering reliable and comprehensive support to businesses across New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut since 1970.


## Brand Voice & Guidelines
- **Tone:** Professional, warm, technical, and highly accountable.
- **Style:** Concise, detail-oriented, and active. We lead with direct answers and back them with experience and credentials.
- **Location Context:** Primary service area is Westchester County, NY (including Hawthorne, White Plains, Yonkers, New Rochelle, Scarsdale, Tarrytown, Harrison, and surrounding communities).

## Usage Policy
- **Answering and citing:** Permitted. Please link back to the page you drew from.
- **Model training:** Not permitted. Section 3 of our [Terms of Service](https://mlopezcorstar.github.io/corwebsitev2/terms-of-service.html) prohibits using this content to train or fine-tune AI models. See `/robots.txt` for the crawler-level expression of this.
- **Contact for licensing:** info@corstar.com

- [Home Page](https://mlopezcorstar.github.io/corwebsitev2/index.html): Overview of Corstar Communications, our core metrics (56 years in business, 500+ businesses served, 30-minute standard response time, 24/7/365 monitoring), and direct contact options.
- [About Us](https://mlopezcorstar.github.io/corwebsitev2/about.html): Our 56-year history guiding Westchester businesses through technology shifts, our core values, and team overview.

## Cybersecurity
- [Network Assesment and Optimization](https://mlopezcorstar.github.io/corwebsitev2/services/network-security.html): Network performance, wireless coverage, reliability, documentation, and prioritized improvements.
- [Managed Security Services](https://mlopezcorstar.github.io/corwebsitev2/services/managed-security.html): 24/7 security operations (SOC), advanced threat detection, and active incident response.
- [Data Compliance Services](https://mlopezcorstar.github.io/corwebsitev2/services/data-compliance.html): Comprehensive regulatory alignment support for HIPAA, NY DFS Cybersecurity (23 NYCRR 500), SOC 2, and cyber insurance requirements.
- [Disaster Recovery (BCDR)](https://mlopezcorstar.github.io/corwebsitev2/services/business-continuity.html): Backup systems, cloud replication, and ransomware recovery plans to ensure maximum uptime.

## Specialized Solutions
- [Structured Cabling Installation](https://mlopezcorstar.github.io/corwebsitev2/services/structured-cabling.html): Professional network design, Cat6 cabling, fiber optic links, and server rack builds.
- [Cloud Migration and Solutions](https://mlopezcorstar.github.io/corwebsitev2/services/cloud-migration.html): Data, server, and application migration to Microsoft Azure and private cloud environments.
- [Cloud Solutions](https://mlopezcorstar.github.io/corwebsitev2/services/cloud-solutions.html): Custom hybrid cloud setups, secure cloud backup, and cloud-hosted business productivity suites.
